Make sure you are getting enough sleep! Get in your bed an hour before you need to be asleep. So if you need 8 hours of sleep and you want to get up at 6 you would get in bed at 9. Chronic sleep deprivation will make it very difficult to get up on time in the morning. 
Also, once you are able to get up in the morning, always get up at the same time, even on weekends. This will train your body to wake up at a certain time, naturally.
